parameters.jsCode:
const faqs = [
  { question: "What is your refund policy?", answer: "We offer full refunds within 30 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number to start the process." },
  { question: "How do I reset my password?", answer: "Click \"Forgot Password\" on the login page and follow the link sent to your registered email." },
  { question: "How do I cancel my subscription?", answer: "Go to Account Settings then Subscription then Cancel Plan. Your access continues until the end of the billing period." },
  { question: "Why was I charged twice?", answer: "Duplicate charges are usually a temporary authorization hold that clears in 3-5 business days. If it persists, contact billing support with the transaction IDs." },
  { question: "How do I update my payment method?", answer: "Go to Account Settings then Billing then Payment Methods to add or update a card." },
  { question: "Do you offer a free trial?", answer: "Yes, all plans include a 14-day free trial with no credit card required." },
  { question: "How do I download my invoice?", answer: "Invoices are available under Account Settings then Billing then Invoice History." },
  { question: "The app keeps crashing when I upload a file. What should I do?", answer: "Try uploading a file smaller than 10MB first. If the issue persists, clear your browser cache or try a different browser." },
  { question: "Why can't I log in even with the correct password?", answer: "Check if Caps Lock is on, or try the Forgot Password flow to reset it. If the issue continues, your account may be temporarily locked after failed attempts." },
  { question: "How do I enable two-factor authentication?", answer: "Go to Account Settings then Security then Two-Factor Authentication and follow the setup steps." },
  { question: "Can I use the app on multiple devices?", answer: "Yes, your account syncs across devices as long as you're logged in with the same credentials." },
  { question: "How do I export my data?", answer: "Go to Account Settings then Data then Export, which generates a downloadable CSV or JSON file of your account data." },
  { question: "Is there an API available?", answer: "Yes, API documentation and keys are available under Developer Settings." },
  { question: "How do I delete my account permanently?", answer: "Go to Account Settings then Danger Zone then Delete Account. This action is irreversible and removes all associated data." },
  { question: "Why is the app running slowly?", answer: "Slow performance is often caused by browser extensions or an outdated browser version. Try disabling extensions or updating your browser." },
  { question: "Do you offer discounts for students or nonprofits?", answer: "Yes, we offer a 20% discount for verified students and registered nonprofits. Apply through the Discounts page." },
  { question: "How do I change my email address?", answer: "Go to Account Settings then Profile then Email, enter the new address, and confirm via the verification link sent to it." },
  { question: "What happens to my data if I cancel my subscription?", answer: "Your data is retained for 30 days after cancellation in case you resubscribe, then permanently deleted." },
  { question: "Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan anytime?", answer: "Yes, plan changes take effect immediately and billing is prorated for the current cycle." },
  { question: "How do I contact support outside business hours?", answer: "Submit a ticket anytime through the support form. Our team responds within 24 hours, including weekends." }
];

return faqs.map(faq => ({ json: faq }));
